name: Three-A Resources Berhad
summary: Three-A Resources Bhd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sale of food and beverage ingredients. Its products include liquid caramel, caramel color, caramel powder, vinegar, glucose syrup, soya protein sauce, maltodextrin, and golden syrup. It operates through the following geographical segments: Malaysia, Singapore, and Other Foreign Countries. The company was founded on April 21, 1999 and is headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia.
